title: ha-notice notification (input)
description: The JSON object read by send --stdin-json or --file. Unknown fields exit 20 invalid_payload. Sanitizing, the 256-character title limit after sanitizing, the empty-message check and the command-keyword check are applied by the tool and are not expressible here.

title.description: Untrusted. At most 256 characters after sanitizing; one line (newlines become spaces). No input maxLength because sanitizing can shorten it.

message.description: Untrusted. At most 100000 characters of input; must not be empty after sanitizing and must not be a command message.

link.description: http or https URL, no whitespace or control characters, no userinfo.
